system.description:
This Dwarf knows the long and sordid past of the various clans—their oaths, grudges, great works of art and the probable size of their hoards and halls.

Obstacles: General history and well-known names, Ob 1. Grudges, Ob 2. Oaths, Ob 3. Obscure deeds or names, Ob 4.

Skill Type: Academic. Tools: No.

Restrictions: Dwarves only in character burning

Root: Perception

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 264
